limitation: Native dispatch transport is encrypted. Pre-dispatch plaintext is retained separately, with ciphertext equality linking dispatch to the child; the plaintext cannot be independently decrypted from the trace. Shared filesystem was bounded by prompts and trace audit, not OS isolation.
native_log_export_policy: Native session remains untouched. Durable export retains original-byte evaluation messages, tool calls/results, visible assistant messages and task boundary events. System/developer harness boilerplate, hidden reasoning and unrelated state are excluded. raw_source/raw_sha256 refer to the native source, not a copied durable raw file.
